promptSections.heading: 一、总风格说明
promptSections.text: A late-Qing gongbi narrative painting on matte silk, interpreted for a contemporary literary game. Fine steady ink contours, flat mineral-pigment glazes, thin washes and subtle ivory silk grain. Azurite, malachite, carmine and ochre; fully colored but restrained. Small natural eyes and pale ink-wash faces, handmade linework in garments and plants. Silk is the painting support, not shiny clothing. <reference-roles>Image 1 supplies only silk ground and fine ink lines, not its bamboo pattern or layout. Image 2 supplies only hair, age and clothing identity for Lin Daiyu. Do not copy its pose, hands, props, composition, glossy face or eye size. Image 3 supplies only garden architecture and planting relationships. Redraw as flat gongbi, without copying its viewpoint, weather or photographic lighting. The current action and matte gongbi style override all reference poses and surfaces.</reference-roles>

promptSections.heading: 二、文学与版本边界说明
promptSections.text: Depict only this present moment, no endings from other editions and no future events. The painting is an artistic interpretation, not literary evidence.

promptSections.heading: 三、地点与场景说明
promptSections.text: A quiet garden path after rain, flanked by green bamboo and a low bamboo fence; wet soil and scattered pale pink petals near a bamboo grove outside a study window. Garden space is staged interpretation. Draw architectural lines and foliage in painted layers. Weather and the indoor/outdoor setting follow the current action, never an unrelated reference pose.

promptSections.heading: 四、人物造型与在场角色说明
promptSections.text: Exactly 1 people, only Lin Daiyu, a slender young woman with fine brows, small restrained eyes, a traditional black updo, pale celadon robes and a muted rose sash. No absent characters, maids or bystanders. Fully clothed, natural hands and clear contact with objects. Keep hair and clothing identity, redraw the bodies for the current action.

promptSections.heading: 五、构图要求
promptSections.text: An asymmetrical medium-wide narrative scene, with the complete action visible and layered plants or architecture. Keep the face within the central sixty percent for mobile viewing. Painted open air, no blank sidebars. One continuous landscape image from edge to edge.

promptSections.heading: 六、光色与情绪要求
promptSections.text: Quiet poetry through restrained gestures, muted malachite, pale ink and ivory air. Soft flat color, no specular highlights.

promptSections.heading: 七、剧情快照说明
promptSections.text: Daiyu crouches low beside the bamboo fence, her left hand holding open a plain pale silk bag at ground level. With her right hand she gathers fallen pale pink petals from the damp soil into the bag. Her head is bowed, her gaze fixed on the bag's opening as she places the blossoms inside. Depict the action, never transcribe the prose. Speech becomes expression, poems remain unlettered paper. Wishes and plans are not completed actions.
